info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Branch Location Retrieval API
info.description: The Branch Location Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information about branch locations in the banking channel. This API supports retrieving specific location data based on dynamic parameters, enabling seamless integration into consumer banking applications. Typical users include developers working on banking services, customer support tools, and location-based services. By facilitating quick access to branch details, this API enhances user experience and drives greater customer satisfaction.

get.summary: Retrieve branch location operations for a specific resource.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the operations related to a specific branch location identified by the resource ID 'RES-100045'. You can use this information to understand the activities and status associated with that branch location.

requestBody.description: This request body should contain the relevant parameters necessary for retrieving information specific to the branch location operations associated with the resource identified by RES-100045. Ensure that all required fields are included as specified in the schema.

200.description: The request was completed successfully, and the response contains the requested branch location data.

GetBranchLocationOperationsRes100045Requ.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on branch location operations.

channelId.description: The unique identifier for the channel.

regionCode.description: The code representing the geographical region.

serviceWindow.description: Information regarding the operational hours of the branch.

dailyCapacity.description: The maximum number of services or transactions that can be handled by the branch in a day.

branchId.description: The unique identifier for the branch.

branchType.description: The type of the branch (e.g., retail, corporate, etc.).

timeZone.description: The time zone in which the branch operates.

recordStatus.description: The status of the branch record (e.g., active, inactive).

version.description: The version number of the branch record.

updatedAt.description: The datetime when the branch record was last updated.

GetBranchLocationOperationsRes100045Resp.description: Response schema for branch location operations in a specific channel, providing information such as channel ID, region code, service window, daily capacity, and other related metadata.

opensAt.description: The time when the branch opens.

closesAt.description: The time when the branch closes.

ServiceWindow.description: The operational hours for a branch, including opening and closing times.

responseId.description: The unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: An identifier used to correlate requests and responses.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the response was processed.

Metadata.description: Metadata containing additional information regarding the response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: An identifier for the endpoint that processed the request, useful for tracking and logging purposes.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that executed the operation, aiding in the identification of the source service.

bearerAuth.description: Authentication scheme using Bearer tokens. This scheme requires a valid JWT (JSON Web Token) to be included in the Authorization header for secure access to API endpoints.
